relationships.subject: Amylin
relationships.evidence_quote: Amylin and CGRP co-expression was observed in 19% (mouse), 17% (rat), and 36% (human) of DRG neurons in distinct vesicle-like neuronal puncta from one another.

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: CTR immunoreactivity was present in DRG neurons, and both peptides produced receptor signalling in primary DRG cell cultures.

relationships.subject: Amylin
relationships.evidence_quote: CTR immunoreactivity was present in DRG neurons, and both peptides produced receptor signalling in primary DRG cell cultures.

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: Concentration-dependent increases in cAMP accumulation were observed in response to both peptides.

key_findings: Amylin mRNA and peptide are present in upper cervical DRG neurons of mouse, rat, and human and co-express with CGRP and CTR.
Both CGRP and amylin increased cAMP in DRG cultures with similar potency.
